Indices of Industrial Production

  • Indices of Industrial Production Forecast
  • data download

Preliminary Report for September 2026 (released at 8:50, October 30, 2026)

  • Industrial Production fluctuates indecisively.
  • Production, Shipments, Inventories and Inventory Ratio increased.
  • According to the Survey of Production Forecast in Manufacturing, Production is expected to increase in October and November.
2020 average=100
Seasonally Adjusted Index Original Index
index Percent change from the previous month(%) index Percent change from the previous year (%)
Production 104.1 2.2 107.9 1.9
Shipments 101.0 0.6 104.7 0.2
Inventories 99.9 2.5 99.3 0.1
Inventory Ratio 108.4 2.0 104.1 2.9

Industrial Production

Industries that mainly contributed to the increased
1.Motor vehicles, 2.Production machinery, 3.General-purpose and business oriented machinery, in that order.
Industries that mainly contributed to the decreased
1.Iron, steel and Non-ferrous metals, 2.Ceramics, stone and clay products, 3.Chemicals (excl. Inorganic, organic chemicals, and medicine), in that order.

Shipments

Industries that mainly contributed to the increased
1.Motor vehicles, 2.General-purpose and business oriented machinery, 3.Transport equipment (excl. motor vehicles), in that order.
Industries that mainly contributed to the decreased
1.Iron, steel and Non-ferrous metals, 2.Petroleum and coal products, 3.Electrical machinery, and Information and communication electronics equipment, in that order.

Inventories

Industries that mainly contributed to the increased
1.Iron, steel and Non-ferrous metals, 2.Motor vehicles, 3.Production machinery, in that order.
Industries that mainly contributed to the decreased
1.Chemicals (excl. Inorganic, organic chemicals, and medicine), 2.Plastic products, 3.Transport equipment (excl. motor vehicles), in that order.

Indices of Industrial Production Forecast*1

Seasonally Adjusted Index
Percent change from the previous month(%)
October 2026 November 2026
Survey in October 2026 5.1 0.8
Survey in September 2026 3.1
Industries that mainly contributed to the increased in October
1.Electronic parts and devices, 2.Production machinery, 3.Electrical machinery, and Information and communication electronics equipment, in that order.
Industries that mainly contributed to the increased in November
1.Transport equipment, 2.General-purpose and business oriented machinery, 3.Iron, steel and Non-ferrous metals, in that order.

*1:Indices of Industrial Production Forecast is conducted monthly to search the planned production amounts for the current and proceeding months.
The survey is one of the useful economic indicators which reflect changing business conditions and provide a view of where the economy is heading in the near future.
